desc: Ideate candidate approaches and select the largest-first greedy with Fenwick tree and triangular-number cost.
Read N and the permutation P, and build a 1-based position array pos[value] = index.
Implement a Fenwick tree supporting point add and prefix sum, initialized with 1 at every position.
Iterate x from N down to 1: let p = prefix_sum(pos[x]), add T(x-1) - T(p-1) to the answer, then remove pos[x] from the Fenwick tree.
Use Python integers for the answer and print it to stdout.
Check the logic against the samples: reverse permutation of 3 gives 4, sample 2 gives 6, and sorted input gives 0.
